announcements.headline: POLB001 CRS Patent Granted in South Korea
announcements.insight: POLB001 CRS patent granted in South Korea follows earlier Israeli allowance. This expands intellectual property protection for the drug alongside recent clinical trial updates.

announcements.headline: POLB 001 TOPICAL trial recruitment update
announcements.insight: Poolbeg Pharma provides a recruitment update for the POLB 001 TOPICAL trial, following interim data released in September. This maintains momentum in the clinical development programme.

announcements.headline: Interim data from POLB 001 TOPICAL clinical trial
announcements.insight: Interim data from the POLB 001 TOPICAL trial follows the July dosing of the first patient. This update provides early clinical evidence for the ongoing development program.

announcements.headline: Key Conference Participation in September 2026
announcements.insight: Poolbeg Pharma will present POLB 001 data at a conference. This follows the first patient dosing in July and recent patent grants.

announcements.headline: Notice of Allowance for POLB 001 patent in Israel
announcements.insight: POLB Pharma secures further international patent protection for POLB 001, complementing earlier grants in Europe and South Africa. This supports the ongoing TOPICAL trial funded by the July placing.

announcements.headline: Placing to raise £3.5 million
announcements.insight: The placing raises funds to support the ongoing POLB 001 TOPICAL trial, which began dosing in July. This capital injection sustains clinical development progress.

announcements.headline: First patient dosed in POLB 001 TOPICAL trial
announcements.insight: The first patient dosed in the POLB 001 TOPICAL trial follows site activation earlier this month. This marks clinical progress for the product.

announcements.headline: POLB 001 patent granted in South Africa
announcements.insight: South African patent grant for POLB 001 follows European approval in June. This expands geographic protection for the topical CRS asset.

announcements.headline: European patent granted for POLB 001 in CRS
announcements.insight: Granting a European patent for POLB 001 follows site activation in June. This protects intellectual property for the topical formulation currently being developed.

announcements.headline: PDMR Notification
announcements.insight: Poolbeg Pharma filed a PDMR notification. This follows recent site activation and data presentations in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Preclinical data posters presented at EHA Congress
announcements.insight: Poolbeg Pharma presents preclinical data at EHA Congress, following POLB 001 TOPICAL site activation in June. This advances its development pipeline.

announcements.headline: Poolbeg Announces POLB 001 TOPICAL Site Activation
announcements.insight: Site activation for POLB 001 TOPICAL follows the AGM. Shareholders should monitor subsequent clinical data releases.

announcements.headline: Results of AGM & Change of Registered Address
announcements.insight: Poolbeg Pharma reports AGM results and a registered address change. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent strategic updates.
